title: TriDot Training Plan Compliance Percent Leaderboard
dataSources: TrainingPeaks workouts (`trainingpeaks:workout`), Garmin multisport activities (`garmin:multisport`), TriDot plans (`tridot:plan`), brick workouts (`brick:workout`), and transition logs (`transition:log`).
app: TrainingPeaks structured workouts, Garmin multisport FIT exports, TriDot training plans, brick workout logs, and transition timing notes ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=tridot:plan compliance_pct=*
| stats sum(compliance_pct) as total_value, avg(compliance_pct) as avg_value by phase
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks training phase values by total and average compliance percent across TriDot training plan events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `compliance_pct` values for each TriDot training plan event and review total and average compliance percent by training phase.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total compliance percent.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates which training phase shows the biggest compliance percent numbers in your TriDot training plan data.
